'''Force Orb''' was a [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|power]] which served as an attack. Through the manifestion of the force an Orb was created of pure [[Force energy]] that obstructed the surrounding environment. Under normal circumstances, it only worked underwater.

[[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] utilized it during the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|Battle of Mon Calamari]], creating a ball of air underwater and directing it through the legs of a [[Quarren]] [[Crab cannon|artillery cannon]], disabling it.<ref name="Chapter 5" />

During the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|Battle of Mon Cala]], Kit Fisto and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] attempted to use this power to make a makeshift air helmet for [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] to breathe when [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]] broke her helmet spitefully with his jaws. They succeeded, but [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks's]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] saliva proved a more effective seal.<ref name="Prisoners">{{TCW|Prisoners}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Force Orb first appeared in the [[Chapter 5 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|fifth episode]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' micro-series, which premiered on [[November 13]], [[2003]].<ref name="Clone Wars Home on Hyperspace">{{SWArchive|url=hyperspace/about/news/news20031024.html|text=''Clone Wars'' Home on Hyperspace}}</ref> The ability was identified as "Force Orb" in ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'', where it appears as an ability for the Xbox Live exclusive Kit Fisto.<ref>{{SWArchive|url=gaming/videogames/news/news20051219.html|text=''Battlefront II'' Bonus Content and Downloadable Expansion}}</ref> Presumably for gameplay purposes, Kit Fisto is capable of using Force Orb without being underwater.
